messages:
Maya R.: Quick sync — ran the eval harness on the new model 'gptx-3q-v2' with INT8 quant, saw a notable regression on the dev-case-suite. Need to triage and decide canary status.
Liam K.: Which metrics and prompt families are affected?
Olivia S.: Mostly instruction-following and dialogue-summary families. I'll attach examples in a sec.
Samir P.: Can you paste the summary diffs (baseline vs candidate)? Also which eval seed/config?
Maya R.: Summary output:
```
model: gptx-3q-v2-int8
eval_suite: dev-case-suite-v3
metric: BLEU
baseline: 0.412
candidate: 0.383
delta: -0.029 (-7.04%)
```
Maya R.: Run config used: `batch_size=8, seq_len=1024, temp=0.0, beam=1, quant=INT8-XT, seed=2026`.
Liam K.: 7% relative is above our informal tolerance. Do we have per-family breakdown? Noise could be concentrated.
Olivia S.: Per-family quick view: instruction-following -5.6%, dialogue-summary -9.1%, qa -0.8%, code-gen +0.3%. Most negative mass in dialogue-summary.
Samir P.: Two suggestions: (1) enforce family-level sample size threshold before treating as gate failure, (2) require human spot-check on top regressions before rollback.
Liam K.: Agree. Current gate in play is: any metric absolute delta > 0.03 OR relative delta > 5% on an anchored family -> fail canary. But that was global; not family-aware.
Olivia S.: Proposal tweak: fail if (a) relative delta > 5% AND family size >= 50 examples, OR (b) absolute delta > 0.03 across top-3 families combined. Add mandatory human review for top-20 worst outputs.
Maya R.: Sounds reasonable. Also want parity checks: tokenization, KV-cache, and decoding determinism between fp16 and INT8 paths. We've seen subtle differences before.
Samir P.: I'll add a quick parity run to compare logits for the first 128 tokens on a fixed seed set. If logits diverge beyond epsilon, that's a red flag for quant path.
Liam K.: I'll re-run the harness deterministically with `seed=42` and `deterministic_sampling=true` and produce per-prompt-family tables + top-20 outputs. ETA ~90m.
eval-bot: Eval run 2245123465 started for gptx-3q-v2-int8 (deterministic, seed=42).
Olivia S.: If the deterministic run still shows the hit concentrated in dialogue-summary, we should prioritize adding more calibration examples for that family and try alternative quant config (INT8-FAST vs INT8-XT).
Maya R.: Action items captured: 1) deterministic re-run (Liam), 2) parity logits check (Samir), 3) human spot-check of top-20 (Olivia/Maya), 4) consider alternative quant profile if confirmed.
Liam K.: Will post results in this thread.
Samir P.: If human review deems outputs unacceptable, we gate the canary and trigger rollback + inform quant team.
Olivia S.: Also note: add a checklist item to the onboarding template: "per-family sample counts and family-aware gate thresholds" so future brings don't miss this.
Maya R.: Good call. Follow-up when eval completes. :thumbsup:
